expectedIssues: Promo banner text is unreadable, white text on a pale mint background
reportedIssues: The promotional banner text (“3 free deliveries for you” and the TALLINN3 code line) uses white text on a very pale mint background, making it hard to read.
The rightmost items in horizontal sections are cut off at the screen edge, e.g. “Trattoria Piccol…” and the category chip after “Healthy”, with no clear fade or scroll indicator.
Favorite/heart controls are inconsistent: the ramen card uses a light outline heart while the pizza card uses a dark circular filled button.
Restaurant names in the “Fastest near you” carousel are truncated, which can make similarly named places hard to distinguish.
